title: Binance Futures Will Launch Coin-Margined NEAR Perpetual Contracts with Up to 20X Leverage
text: Fellow Binancians, Binance Futures will launch coin-margined NEAR perpetual contracts with up to 20x leverage at 2021-12-15 03:30 AM (UTC). Please note: NEAR perpetual contracts are coin-margined futures contracts that use NEAR as collateral.  Further information: Trading Rules of COIN-M Futures Contracts Leverage and Margin of COIN-M Futures Contracts Binance Futures Fee Schedule How to Select Trading Pairs Price Index Risk Warning : Futures trading carries substantial risk and the possibility of both significant profits and losses.
